descripcion: PRIMERA PUERTA DEL CAPITULO. Entrega una muerte confirmada y la primera prueba citable.
_por_que_la_muerte_va_ANTES_de_las_pregu: La muerte va antes de las preguntas: lo que da una puerta, lo da siempre.
_guion: Texto del Guion jugable del Acto I.

knock.texto: Good evening. I am Mr Whitehead, from St Luke's.

death.texto: You have come about my brother-in-law. He was well at noon on Friday. By eleven that night he was dead.

nombre_q.texto: I am sorry. What was his name?

nombre.texto: George Carr. His brother Thomas went first, on Wednesday. My husband. Now George.

the_air.texto: It is the bad air. I have stuffed rags in every crack since Tuesday.

forty_one.texto: Ask at number 41. She watches the street all day. If anyone has been carried out, she saw it.

otra_vez.texto: I have nothing more to tell you, Reverend. Pray for them.

_sin_agua: Sin pregunta del agua: regalaba la respuesta.
_pivote: Dos nombres y dos días a propósito; la ficha pide al cuñado (George, viernes).
